verdict.rationale: The docs show that `byteask models add <alias> --provider ...` connects OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras or Fireworks with your own key. Any OpenAI-compatible model can be driven in the TUI like a built-in cloud model, and the default `auto` mode chains three models across two providers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how a model is selected or switched for a given session (e.g. a flag or slash command), independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
